text:
Luca (growth): Need a tiny launch-ready benchmark frame for the site + webinar. Keep it snackable: 2 visuals, 1 headline, 3 bullets max.
Amrita (data): Agree. My take: Visual A = scatter of latency (ms) vs unit cost ($/1k tokens) with P50/P95 callouts. Visual B = 1-row decision flow for routing.
Jon (design): Visual constraints noted. Use two clusters: quantized throughput vs high-accuracy. Use muted SLA bands behind chart for context. Headline must be punchy and <10 words.
Priya (prod): Audience = infra leads + PMs. We need one-liner webinar CTA that promises practical knobs (batching, routing, quantization). 20m demo slot.
Luca (growth): Headline options: "Latency-first or cost-first? Tune for both." Keep it bold.
Amrita (data): I'll run two microbench slices: chat-short (64) and long-context (1024). Bench job queued id=92345. CSV will be posted.
BenchBot: job 92345 queued. ETA ~5m. :robot_face:
Amrita (data): BenchBot finished: https://internal/bench/92345.csv Quick highlights pasted: chat-short P95=90ms cost=$0.08/1k; long quantized P95=300ms cost=$0.048/1k; long unquant P95=740ms cost=$0.13/1k.
Jon (design): Perfect. I'll make: PNG A = cluster scatter (annotate P95s), PNG B = compact flow with threshold line at 150ms. Alt text included.
Priya (prod): Routing rule suggestion: if end-to-end <150ms -> fastpath; else -> econpath. Add override flag per-customer SLA.
Luca (growth): Copy bullets for Visual A: 1) "P95 maps to perceived speed" 2) "Quantization cuts unit cost on long contexts" Visual B bullets: 1) "Auto-route for UX-critical requests" 2) "Fallback to accurate model when needed"
Jon (design): Will keep each chart headline <=12 words and add a small token-to-dollar example labeled 'example'.
Priya (prod): Webinar promo line draft: "Join our 20m demo: tune serving for latency and dollars." Benefits: 1) reduce tail latency, 2) lower token spend, 3) maintain quality. Sign-up link placeholder.
Luca (growth): Final checklist: 2 PNGs + alt text, headline, 4 bullets total, token example, CSV link, 1-line webinar CTA. Target: EOD. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
Amrita (data): Numbers done. Happy to re-run slices if design wants different thresholds.
Jon (design): I'll drop assets here within the hour.
Priya (prod): I'll draft landing copy after visuals land.
Luca (growth): Thanks team — will stitch into the launch page and webinar invite once assets are in.
